title: MOTUL BREAK-IN OIL 10W40 (1L)
description:
MOTUL BREAK-IN OIL 10W-40

High-Performance Conventional Engine Break-In Oil

Motul Break-In Oil 10W-40 is a high-performance conventional mineral lubricant specially formulated for running-in all types of 4-stroke engines in both automotive and powersports applications. Designed for both standard rebuilds and high-output competition engines, its ZDDP-fortified formula ensures fast, safe seating of piston rings and cylinder walls while shielding flat-tappet camshafts and valvetrain components from early scuffing and wear.

**Official Key Features & Technical Bullet Points**

* High-ZDDP Fortified: Extra zinc and phosphorus levels reinforce critical contact points, protecting flat-tappet cams, lifters, rockers, and high-lift valvetrains.
* Ring-Sealing Efficiency: Formulated with balanced friction modifiers that promote controlled surface mating for fast ring seating without cylinder glazing.
* Shear-Stable Viscosity: Maintains an optimum protective oil film and ring seal under high heat and heavy load during initial run-in procedures.
* Clean Break-In Additives: Controlled detergent/dispersant pack prevents sludge and deposit formation while allowing the engine components to seat properly.
* Powersports & Wet-Clutch Compatible: Meets JASO MA2 standards, making it safe for wet clutches and integrated gearboxes in motorcycles, ATVs, and UTVs.
